curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42095-1-1.pdf (the racer; its functions on page 63, opening it to change the batteries on pages 64-65)

functions.does: The left track: a Power Functions L motor, worked by one lever on the remote through the IR receiver, turns a 16 tooth gear on its shaft, which drives the 16 tooth gear on the big yellow sprocket at the back of the left track, running the track forward or back.
functions.source: book: steps 1-12 (the motors, their output gears and the sprocket axles, pages 7-12), 27-30 (the sprockets), 83 (the tracks); page 63 (the remote and the arrows)
functions.note: the motor (p103 99499) is one rigid part; the control named is the gear on its output shaft

functions.does: The right track: the other L motor, worked by the remote's other lever, drives the right track's big yellow sprocket the same way.
functions.note: the motor (p0 99499) is one rigid part; the control named is the gear on its output shaft

functions.does: Steering is by the two tracks: both levers the same way drive the racer forward or back, one track alone turns it, and the two tracks running opposite ways spin it on the spot.
functions.source: book: page 63 (the four pictures of the remote and the racer's moves)
functions.note: follows from the two track functions above; nothing else is worked

functions.does: The blue top hinges forward on pins at its front to reach the battery box: unplug the two flexible hoses, pull out the pin that holds it down, and tip it up and over.
functions.source: book: pages 64-65 (changing the batteries: steps 2-6, the arrow on the top at step 4)
functions.note: in the model file the pin and hoses are already as built, holding the top down

functions.does: The two small yellow wheels on the tail, behind and above the tracks, roll freely, so the racer can run on them when it rears up.
functions.source: inferred: from where they sit, behind the tracks and clear of the ground; the book doesn't show them in use

questions.question: Are the tail's yellow wheels wheelie rollers?
